text: Not to brag, but yesterday I beat the state chess champion in less than five moves. Finally my high school karate lessons came to some use.
gist: Man brags he beat the state chess champion in a few moves, then reveals he used karate, so the beating was physical.

wordplay.explanation: 'beat' means defeating in a game and physically hitting.

text: Dad (having an heart attack): Son call me an ambulance... Son actually calls an ambulance. Dad dies of disappointment.
gist: Dad having a heart attack asks his son to call him an ambulance, the son simply calls one instead of making the expected pun, and dad dies of disappointment.

wordplay.explanation: 'call me an ambulance' can mean phone an ambulance or address me as 'an ambulance'; the son misses the classic pun.

wordplay.explanation: 'All the signs were there' means all the evidence pointed to it, and literally the stolen road signs were in the house.
